scenarios.title: A｜押金
scenarios.setting: 在“退租费用争议”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“押金”。

turns.text: Hi, I’m calling about my security deposit. I haven’t received it yet.
Part of the deposit is being held for some repairs.

turns.prompt: 你想了解押金扣款的依据和金额，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you tell me what repairs the money is being used for?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me what repairs the money is being used for?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: How much of the deposit are you keeping?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much of the deposit are you keeping?
feedback.explanation: “deposit”指押金或订金，具体是否退还需看当前安排。

choices.text: Could you send me a breakdown of the charges?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you send me a breakdown of the charges?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: When will I receive the rest of the deposit?

feedback.naturalExpression: When will I receive the rest of the deposit?
feedback.explanation: “deposit”指押金或订金，具体是否退还需看当前安排。

choices.text: Why you don’t give my deposit back?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you tell me what repairs the money is being used for?
feedback.explanation: 直接问原因要说“Why don’t you …?”，把助动词放在主语前；此处若目的是解决订房问题，问替代方案更有帮助。

turns.text: I’ll send you a list of the charges.

turns.prompt: 关于「退租费用争议」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Thanks. I’d like to review that before anything is deducted.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’d like to review that before anything is deducted.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Could you also send me any photos related to the damage?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you also send me any photos related to the damage?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Okay. Please send that to me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Please send that to me.
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

scenarios.title: B｜清洁费用
scenarios.setting: 在“退租费用争议”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“清洁费用”。

turns.prompt: 你想请房东解释清洁费用，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you explain what the cleaning charge is for?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain what the cleaning charge is for?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: How much are you charging for cleaning?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much are you charging for cleaning?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

choices.text: I cleaned the apartment before I left. Could you tell me what still needed cleaning?

feedback.naturalExpression: I cleaned the apartment before I left. Could you tell me what still needed cleaning?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Was this cleaning fee included in the lease?

feedback.naturalExpression: Was this cleaning fee included in the lease?
feedback.explanation: “lease”指租约，通常涉及租住期限和合同条件。

choices.text: Why I need pay cleaning money?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you explain what the cleaning charge is for?
feedback.explanation: “need”后接动作时通常用“need to + 动词原形”。补上“to”，才能把“需要”和具体动作连接起来。

turns.prompt: 你想进一步核对清洁收费对应的具体问题，会怎么说？

choices.text: Which parts of the kitchen needed cleaning?

feedback.naturalExpression: Which parts of the kitchen needed cleaning?
feedback.explanation: 用简短问句核对刚听到的信息，省略的部分由前面的对话补足，适合当面确认细节。

choices.text: Do you have photos from the final inspection?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you have photos from the final inspection?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Could you send me an itemized cleaning bill?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you send me an itemized cleaning bill?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d like to understand the charge before I agree to it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to understand the charge before I agree to it.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

scenarios.title: C｜房屋损坏
scenarios.setting: 在“退租费用争议”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“房屋损坏”。

turns.text: We also found some damage to the bedroom wall.

turns.prompt: 你想查看房东所说的房屋损坏情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: What kind of damage did you find?

feedback.naturalExpression: What kind of damage did you find?
feedback.explanation: “kind of”口语中表示有点、算是，常用来缓和对自身或事情的描述。

choices.text: Could you show me a photo of it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you show me a photo of it?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Was that noted during the final inspection?

feedback.naturalExpression: Was that noted during the final inspection?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

choices.text: How much are you charging for the repair?

feedback.naturalExpression: How much are you charging for the repair?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

turns.text: There are several holes in the wall where something was mounted.

turns.prompt: 你想表示理解对方的解释或立场，会怎么说？

choices.text: I understand. Could you send me an estimate for the repair?

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Could you send me an estimate for the repair?
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。

choices.text: I don’t think I caused that damage. Could we check the move-in photos?

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think I caused that damage. Could we check the move-in photos?
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Those marks were already there when I moved in. I have photos from my first day.

feedback.naturalExpression: Those marks were already there when I moved in. I have photos from my first day.
feedback.explanation: “already”强调事情已经发生或完成，适合核对进度与时间先后。

choices.text: If I’m responsible for it, how will the repair cost be calculated?

feedback.naturalExpression: If I’m responsible for it, how will the repair cost be calculated?
feedback.explanation: “responsible for”表示负责某项工作，能用来确认任务归属。

choices.text: That’s not my problem. I won’t pay.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I understand. Could you send me an estimate for the repair?
feedback.explanation: 一口否认付款责任会让协商僵住；要求查看费用依据或明细，更能支持自己的立场。

turns.text: Sure. Send me your photos and I’ll compare them with our records.

turns.prompt: 关于「退租费用争议」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, I’ll send them over now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I’ll send them over now.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Thanks. I’d like to clear this up before the deposit is finalized.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’d like to clear this up before the deposit is finalized.
feedback.explanation: “deposit”指押金或订金，具体是否退还需看当前安排。
